verdict.rationale: The only first-party natural-language command surface in the evidence is the onboarding AI Form Builder, where a user describes a form and it is generated. That is a narrow, single-feature instance, not general natural-language operation of the product. Other AI features (Talent Fit matching, transcripts, interview-guide generation) are AI outputs, not natural-language control, and Automation Hub is rule-based automation. Missing for 10: a general natural-language assistant or command interface for operating the ATS (searching candidates, advancing stages, scheduling, reporting), documentation of its depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: With the AI Form Builder, just describe the form you need, and it's generated instantly
